content.user_title: Evaluate Technology Stacks With TCO Insight
content.value_statement: Technology choices are hard to compare when cost, security, ecosystem health, and migration risk are scattered. This skill turns stack decisions into scored recommendations, TCO analysis, security posture, and migration guidance.
actual_capabilities: Compares frameworks, languages, databases, and cloud providers with weighted scoring.
Estimates total cost of ownership across licensing, hosting, productivity, and scaling factors.
Assesses security posture and compliance readiness for common enterprise standards.
Reviews ecosystem maturity using maintenance, community, and corporate backing signals.
Analyzes migration complexity, risk, timeline, and rollback considerations.
Generates decision reports for CLI and Claude Desktop style outputs.
limitations: Scores depend on the quality and completeness of the supplied requirements.
Recommendations do not replace hands-on benchmarking or formal security review.
Public ecosystem metrics can change and should be verified before final decisions.
Migration estimates need accurate system size, dependency, and integration details.

use_cases.title: Choose a Frontend Framework
use_cases.description: Compare React, Vue, Angular, or Svelte for team fit, ecosystem health, performance needs, and long-term maintainability.

use_cases.title: Plan a Platform Migration
use_cases.description: Assess migration effort, delivery risk, rollback options, and phased paths from a legacy stack to a modern stack.

use_cases.title: Validate Enterprise Readiness
use_cases.description: Review security posture, compliance gaps, vendor risk, and operational fit before approving a new technology choice.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Framework Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner comparison for a common engineering decision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare React and Vue for a SaaS dashboard. Focus on developer productivity, ecosystem maturity, performance, and hiring availability.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Complete Stack
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured review of an application architecture.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this stack for a real-time collaboration product: Next.js, Node.js, WebSockets, Redis, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Include risks and a recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Estimate Ownership Cost
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate total cost of ownership for AWS versus Azure for a workload with 50 compute instances, 10 TB storage, and high bandwidth use.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Weighted Decision Matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare React, Vue, Svelte, and Angular for enterprise SaaS. Weight maintainability 35%, hiring 25%, performance 20%, ecosystem 15%, and migration risk 5%.

output_examples.input: Compare React and Vue for a SaaS dashboard used by a ten-person product team.
output: Recommendation: React, with high confidence for ecosystem depth and hiring availability.
Vue remains strong when the team values simpler onboarding and smaller application scope.
Key tradeoff: React has broader tooling, while Vue can reduce initial implementation complexity.

output_examples.input: Assess whether we should migrate from MongoDB to PostgreSQL for reporting-heavy workloads.
output: Recommendation: PostgreSQL is favored when relational reporting and transactional consistency are primary goals.
Migration risk is moderate because data modeling, query rewrites, and validation work are required.
Suggested path: prototype critical reports, migrate bounded domains first, and keep rollback checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Evaluate AWS, Azure, and GCP for a machine learning workload with GPU requirements.
output: The comparison ranks providers by GPU availability, cost predictability, managed service fit, and team expertise.
The report highlights procurement constraints, regional capacity, support needs, and lock-in risk.
The final recommendation includes a confidence score and assumptions to validate before procurement.

best_practices: Provide concrete workload size, team skills, compliance needs, and growth assumptions.
Set weighted priorities before asking for a recommendation.
Validate the final recommendation with current benchmarks, security data, and vendor pricing.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a generic best technology without a use case.
Do not treat scores as final proof without checking assumptions.
Do not omit migration constraints, team experience, or operational requirements.

faq.question: What does this skill evaluate?
faq.answer: It evaluates technology choices across fit, cost, ecosystem health, security posture, and migration complexity.

faq.question: Can it compare cloud providers?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare AWS, Azure, and GCP for workload fit, cost factors, feature coverage, and operational risk.

faq.question: Does it fetch live technology data?
faq.answer: The documentation describes support for public ecosystem data, but important numbers should be verified before decisions.

faq.question: Can it replace a security review?
faq.answer: No. It can surface security and compliance considerations, but formal reviews and current vulnerability checks remain necessary.

faq.question: What input works best?
faq.answer: Specific requirements work best, including workload type, scale, team size, compliance needs, budget, and decision priorities.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
